Multi-Channel Integration for Shopify

Shopify multi-channel integration is how modern commerce brands sell across Shopify, Amazon, eBay, Walmart, TikTok Shop and wholesale channels simultaneously — without the operational overhead that scales with every channel you add. Without Shopify multi-channel integration, each new sales channel means new manual work. With proper Shopify multi-channel integration, new channels add revenue without adding complexity. Agentix builds Shopify multi-channel integration solutions that unify your inventory, centralize order management and keep product data synchronized across every sales channel. Our Shopify Amazon integration, Shopify eBay integration, omnichannel ecommerce solutions and marketplace integrations Shopify cover every channel you sell on.

What's included

Everything you get with Multi-Channel Integration for Shopify.

01

Marketplace integration

Shopify connected to Amazon Seller Central, eBay, Walmart Marketplace and TikTok Shop — with product listing sync, inventory updates and order import managed automatically.

02

Unified inventory management

Real-time inventory sync across all connected sales channels — preventing oversells, automating reorder triggers and giving your operations team a single view of stock levels.

03

Centralized order management

Orders from all channels pulled into Shopify or your OMS — processed, fulfilled and tracked from a single interface without switching between platforms.

04

Product catalog sync

Product titles, descriptions, images, pricing and variant data synchronized across all channels — updated once in your master catalog, propagated everywhere automatically.

05

Wholesale & retail EDI

EDI integration for wholesale channel orders from large retail partners — translating EDI transactions into Shopify orders and automating acknowledgment and fulfilment responses.

06

Channel performance reporting

Unified reporting across all sales channels — revenue, units sold, channel profitability and inventory performance in a single dashboard.

How it works

A clear path from audit to growth.

Step 01

Audit

Mapping your current channel setup, inventory flow, order volumes and the specific problems multi-channel creates for your operation.

Step 02

Design

Integration architecture design — channel connections, inventory sync logic, order routing rules and catalog management approach.

Step 03

Build

Integration development and end-to-end testing with real data across all channels.

Step 04

Launch

Phased rollout starting with your highest-volume channels, with intensive monitoring during cutover.
